_comment: Configuration for app-add-montage - Add electrode montage to MNE raw data
raw_comment: Path to input MNE raw data file (.fif format)
montage_comment: Name of standard montage to apply (e.g., 'standard_1020', 'standard_1005', 'GSN-HydroCel-257', 'GSN-HydroCel-128')
rename_channels_comment: Optional comma-separated list of channel renamings (format: old_name-new_name,old_name2-new_name2). Leave empty or use 'None' if not needed.
